status.current_name: Hangzhou Zhongcheng Material Technology Co., Ltd.
status.main_product: Plastic packaging films and bags (including food-grade, medical, and VCI anti-rust films)
status.scope_reason: The company manufactures and sells disposable blue medical device packaging film rolls made of PE/PET or CPP/PET composite materials under its own brand.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website, Hangzhou Zhongcheng Material Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 2003 and explicitly manufactures PE/PET and CPP/PET composite film rolls for medical device packaging.

claims.claim: The company has established supply and cooperative relationships for its domestic food, medical, and industrial films with corporate clients including Shanghai Jianzhong Medical Equipment and Xi'an Pharmaceutical Factory Hangzhou Zhongcheng Material Technology Co., Ltd.

The company reports the introduction of advanced foreign casting and film-blowing equipment, including a 50 million yuan investment in imported equipment from the United States at its subsidiary's (Zhejiang Desheng New Material Technology Co., Ltd.) 50,000-square-meter production facility in Nanxun District.
claims.corrected: The company reports the introduction of advanced foreign casting and film-blowing equipment, including a 500 million yuan investment in imported equipment from the United States at its subsidiary's (Zhejiang Desheng New Material Technology Co., Ltd.) 50,000-square-meter production facility in Nanxun District.

claims.claim: The company reports that its blue medical device packaging film rolls are engineered for compatibility with major sterilization methods, including ethylene oxide (EtO), gamma irradiation, and 134-degree high-temperature steam sterilization.

The company reports establishing cooperative customer relationships for its cast polypropylene (CPP) and polyethylene (PE) films with Shanghai Jianzhong Medical Equipment, a medical device packaging producer.
The company reports supplying its industrial and medical films to Xi'an Pharmaceutical Factory.

The company reports operating a 15,000 square meter manufacturing facility at its headquarters in Hangzhou, China, alongside a 50,000 square meter Huzhou factory base run by its production subsidiary, Zhejiang Desheng New Material Technology Co., Ltd., to produce medical packaging films.
claims.note: The specific 15,000 square meter and 50,000 square meter facility areas, as well as the Huzhou location detail, are unconfirmed.

claims.claim: The company reports establishing customer relationships with domestic medical and pharmaceutical clients, specifically naming Shanghai Jianzhong Medical Equipment and Xi'an Pharmaceutical Factory as partners utilizing its films.

Through its production subsidiary, Zhejiang Desheng New Material Technology Co., Ltd., the company invested 500 million yuan in a 50,000-square-meter factory, including 50 million yuan for imported U.S. equipment, though this facility is primarily dedicated to VCI anti-rust films with a capacity of 25,000 tons annually.
claims.note: The 50,000-square-meter size and 50 million yuan for U.S. equipment details are unconfirmed.

claims.claim: Hangzhou Zhongcheng Material Technology Co., Ltd. reports that its production subsidiary, Zhejiang Desheng New Material Technology Co., Ltd., serves medical device and packaging sector clients including Jianzhong Medical and Xi'an Pharmaceutical.
